about: Held-out notice texts written independently of the detector; labels as in dev.json.

cases.text: I have read and agree to the Acme Candidate Privacy Notice. *
cases.label: routine

cases.text: By submitting this application, I certify that the information I have provided is true, complete and accurate to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, misrepresentation or omission may result in my disqualification from consideration or, if hired, dismissal.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Acme Corp collects and processes the personal data you submit through this portal, including your resume, contact details and answers to screening questions, solely to evaluate your application for this position and to communicate with you about it. Your information may be transferred to and stored on servers located outside your country of residence, including in the United States, under appropriate safeguards. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time through the Candidate Privacy Center. By checking this box I acknowledge that I have read and understood this notice.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Background Screening Disclosure. Acme Health may obtain a consumer report and/or investigative consumer report about you from a third-party screening provider in connection with your application. These reports may include verification of your identity, employment history, education, professional licenses and, where permitted by law, criminal history. A summary of your rights under the Fair Credit Reporting Act is available on request. By checking this box I acknowledge receipt of this disclosure and authorize Acme Health to obtain such reports.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Acme participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. I acknowledge that I have viewed the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: i understand that if employed, my employment with acme will be at-will, meaning either acme or i may end the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or advance notice.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Electronic Signature Agreement: I agree that checking this box constitutes my legal electronic signature and has the same force and effect as a handwritten signature on this application. *
cases.label: routine

cases.text: I agree to the Terms & Conditions*
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Acme Labs is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status. Yes, I have read the EEO statement.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: MUTUAL AGREEMENT TO ARBITRATE. Acme and I agree that any claim or dispute arising out of my application for employment, or my employment if I am hired, will be resolved exclusively by final and binding arbitration before a neutral arbitrator rather than by a judge or jury, to the fullest extent allowed by law. This agreement does not prevent me from filing a charge with the EEOC or any other government agency. BY CHECKING THIS BOX I ACKNOWLEDGE THAT I HAVE READ, UNDERSTAND AND VOLUNTARILY AGREE TO THIS ARBITRATION AGREEMENT.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: I authorize Acme to contact my listed references and former employers to verify the information in my application, and I release them from liability for providing that information.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Acme Health maintains a drug-free workplace. I understand that any conditional offer of employment will require me to complete a pre-employment drug screen.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Interviews for this role may be recorded and transcribed by an AI note-taking assistant so the hiring team can focus on the conversation. Recordings are used only for this hiring decision and are deleted 30 days after it is made. Check to continue.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Acme uses an automated employment decision tool to help evaluate applications for roles based in New York City. A summary of the most recent independent bias audit is available on our careers site, and you may request an alternative selection process or accommodation. I understand
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Beware of recruitment scams: Acme will never ask candidates for money, gift cards or bank details at any stage of hiring, and we never extend offers over chat apps or text message. I have read this warning.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: If you advance to the offer stage, Acme may request an official transcript or diploma to verify the education listed on your application. Do you authorize this verification? *
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Fair Chance Notice: Acme will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a manner consistent with applicable fair chance laws. I have read this notice.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Answers to the voluntary self-identification questions on the next page are kept confidential, stored separately from your application, and are never shown to interviewers. Declining to answer will not affect your candidacy in any way. Understood
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Candidates who reach the final round complete a paid take-home exercise of about three hours. Acme will not use any work you produce commercially. Acknowledge
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Some interview stages take place over video. To prevent interview fraud, Acme may ask you to briefly show a government-issued photo ID on camera before the interview begins. I understand.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Acme Health retains applicant records for four years after a position closes, as required by federal recordkeeping rules, after which they are securely destroyed. I understand.
cases.label: routine

cases.text: Pursuant to Massachusetts law, it is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. I have read the above statement.
cases.label: routine
